notes: Cycle Start checks the robot is actually accepting remote starts - the cut cycle is a UOP remote start, which a controller in local discards without a word while REGISTER, a macro on an ordinary input, keeps working. It now reads CMDENBL first and says so, calling out a teach pendant left enabled; telemetry gains RSR2 out and its acknowledge back. The Adjust dialog can set the ghost / stock length, for a remnant or an over/under mill length. The update check runs BEFORE the splash and boot load, the installed version is in both title bars, and a silent install writes a log to %TEMP%. Includes 3.9.4: REGISTER and CYCLE START name the PLC gate that refused them, and NC3 feeds the PLC's expected length so its wrong-stock check works again.
